story.vibe: The venue's own description on Skiddle promises sound that is warm but never noisy, with a vinyl-only line-up of residents providing the soundtrack. Its list of styles runs from trip hop and dub to soul, disco, jazz and funk, plus mellow drum n bass.
worth_knowing: The venue is on two floors in Shoreditch, and its basement can be used for a private party.
The venue also runs a midweek listening session where classic albums are played through from start to finish.
